The '''Gwaria Trench''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. It was the site of a [[Battle of Gwaria Trench|battle]] between [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] troopers and [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] raiders.<ref name="TOR" />
